0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 8th in the West and 1.5 games behind in the Pacific, with a 0-1 road record) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 1st in the Northwest, 2nd in the West) for their third game of the season, coming off a win. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, and Otega Oweh, and Phoenix is missing Mark Williams and Oso Ighodaro. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-3 and their 2025-26 playoff series 0-4, including a 131-122 defeat in Phoenix on April 27.
